## E2 — Erratum against Addendum 1 §2.1

Addendum 1 wrote: *"Strong selection = forced-vs-chosen — untouched by this addendum, by the parent review, and by the rung-3 arc — as everyone has said all along."* The clause "as everyone has said all along" is the error, and it is the same species as E1 one stratum up: a review-layer consensus ("the forced-vs-chosen floor, untouched" — 07-20, 07-22, 07-24, parent review, Addendum 1) propagated in place of the canon's own graded statement, which has been materially stronger since June 29:

> **[A7], canon, firm:** "TEP's foundations are *forced at the metric-space level* (measure-completeness ⟺ statistical-sufficiency ⇒ L²/Fisher; conditioning ⇒ SO(1,1); compositionality ⇒ Lorentz; homogeneity ⇒ cascade), **modulo named lemmas O-a/O-d/O-e. The three V2 axioms are derived, not assumed.** Metric and system are geometrically-bounded residuals."

> **The metric-space resolution [Will, load-bearing, 06-29]:** "every forced step lands on the **space** (ℝH²/SU(1,1), two-point-homogeneous via Wang–Tits, modulo the one owed lemma O-a). The **metric** (which Petz f) is the residual *shape* freedom *inside* that fixed space… the axiom decides the space; metric-freedom and system-realization are bounded residuals."

"Untouched floor" flattens a mostly-discharged, explicitly-itemized derivation into a binary open — misrepresentation in the *open* direction, the reviewer's mirror image of claim inflation.

## 1. The derivation, as documented (locations and tiers)

Will's three claims check against source, each with its documentation:

1. **The budget is derived from first principles.** Twice over. The original chain: positivity (constitutive) → passivity ≡ boundedness ≡ positive-realness ≡ normalization (one equivalence class, derived — "a positive trace-preserving map is a contraction") → invariant conserved ensemble, with **x² + u = 1 as the partition of unity** (06-09 §§2–3, steps 1–3 all [T]/constitutive). And the sharper modern form: **Theorem P** (07-19 completeness-reduction, three-line proofs, [V] 9/9): *any* passive (positive, unital, state-preserving) interface budgets — identity, non-negativity, monotonicity, telescoping ledger — with the load-bearing hypothesis (state-preservation) exhibited by counterexample. The budget needs no posit at all; it is the passivity signature, and completeness buys the *readable surplus* on top.
2. **The generic metric is defined and unique, with the extensions as stated.** Thread L (06-29, [std/T]): completeness/sufficiency forces L² — the law of total variance holding *for every conditioning* ⟺ conditional expectation is an orthogonal projection ⟺ Jordan–von Neumann quadratic dispersion, **which fails in every Lᵖ, p ≠ 2** — hence Riemannian, with **Fisher–Rao the unique quadratic germ** (Čencov/Amari–Nagaoka/AJLS). The extensions beyond the Chentsov regime are exactly two, and they are the decomposition's axes ([V] structural, 06-09 §6): **Campbell** (relax normalization → the cone's radial/scale axis) and **Petz** (relax commutativity → the fiber/shape axis), with Chentsov the doubly-constrained intersection. Nothing is selected anywhere in this: the base is forced, the cone form is forced-with-two-mass-functions, the fiber multiplicity is the *bounded residual inside a pinned space* — structure, not slack. 6-02 §11 then derives the signature (the invariant quadratic on the cone is uniquely Lorentzian; SU(1,1) a consequence), and O-a's exclusion battery (06-10, [V]) forces ℝH² among the model geometries given (H*).
3. **"Strong selection is not open" — correct, and the phrase should be retired.** The 06-20 [I1] definition of strong selection was "deriving the operative package from first principles." That derivation exists and is the chain above. What the review layer kept calling "the forced-vs-chosen floor" is, per canon, an itemized short list: **O-a** (two-point homogeneity — now a *stated conditional theorem* whose entire residue is (H*), the budget-arena relativity principle, with its derivation target named: completeness/conditioning itself); **O-d** (sufficiency structure from completeness + dilation existence — tagged **[A→T candidate]** with the classical route named: Stinespring/Naimark + AJLS §5 factorization); **O-e** (the (1,d) counting at d > 2, instantiation-anchored); plus **one base postulate** (compositionality/scale-independence, the G-multiplicativity first principle) and the **per-register instantiation question** (Delta 7's "one question asked twice" — provable in the arithmetic register via Peter–Weyl, empirical elsewhere, and *not a foundations gap* but the domain-of-applicability clause every physical theory carries; nobody files "does this system satisfy the axioms of mechanics" as an open problem of mechanics). Three named lemmas with routes, one declared postulate, one applicability clause. That is a working mathematician's ledger, not an open floor.

## 2. The mechanism worth naming (why the review layer kept doing this)

"The floor remains open" is the *safe-sounding* reviewer position: it reads as calibration, costs no reading of the chain, and inherits authority from 5-29's bottom line — which each successive review re-endorsed partly *as a display of its own sobriety*. It is the absence-claim failure mode (assert-open without sweeping) wearing skepticism's clothes, and it produced a four-review consensus that under-credited canon for a month. The sweep-first rule applies symmetrically: to "X is established" *and* to "X is still open."
